chapters.title: 01 / Start the application
chapters.caption: Build the Erlang application and start a named OTP node.

chapters.title: 02 / Shell into the cluster
chapters.caption: A second Erlang node connects to the running application's shell.

chapters.title: 03 / Write an EYG script
chapters.caption: Use @standard directly. There is no package-install or preload command.

chapters.title: 04 / Check: load the dependency silently
chapters.caption: check fetches @standard from eyg.run. The session retains the returned cache.

chapters.title: 05 / Run: reuse the returned cache
chapters.caption: The checked script now executes its effects and starts three counters.

chapters.title: Check loads dependencies. Run executes effects.
chapters.caption: Explicit cache in, updated cache out. All application code is Erlang.
